0x0007E2.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x000814.en: 「My skills just aren't enough...@ this is my limit...!」

0x000885.en: 「Gah!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x00090D.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000987.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B37.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B72.en: 「I'm not blowing it here...!@　This is no fun...」

0x000BC6.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000CB0.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D17.en: 「This is the end for me... the rest is yours.」

0x000DC3.en: 「No good, took too many hits... falling back!」

0x000E10.en: 「Well, I'm beat. Leave the rest to you.」

0x000E4E.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you all!」

0x000E95.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F40.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd become a shooting star... ejecting!」

0x000FF7.en: 「Owowow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x00107C.en: 「U...ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x0010E9.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001130.en: 「I'm sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001165.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!?」

0x0011A9.en: 「I can't fight anymore! I'm pulling back!」

0x001251.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x00129F.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! I'm retreating!」

0x00135A.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001389.en: 「No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013C7.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013F6.en: 「I can't go any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x001481.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll have to pull back...!」

0x001977.en: 「Even with my psychic power, I can't cut off the Psycho Clutch...@ Unless the wavelengths match perfectly, it's impossible.」

0x001A0D.en: 「Couldn't we just swap out the T-LINK System itself?」

0x001A78.en: 「But the setup would take time, and Ashe would be out of commission.」

0x001AE6.en: 「Besides, the same thing might just happen again...」

0x001B32.en: 「Yeah, I saw the startup data too.@ Someone booted it from outside and took control of the unit.」

0x001BA9.en: 「If the power was on, maybe...@ but a stunt like that is beyond me.」

0x001C14.en: 「...Were the Gaia Sabers training espers too?」

0x001C76.en: 「Ariel never mentioned anything like that, though...」

0x001CD2.en: 「When it comes to the T-LINK, my father is the authority...」

0x001D21.en: 「So until we get it to Dr. Kobayashi, Ashe stays Ing's personal unit, huh...@ I kind of wanted a turn in it.」

0x001E0D.en: 「Hey, no big deal.@ You're piloting Ashe just fine,@ and we're getting good data out of it.」

0x001E9D.en: 「By the way, Rob...@ how long is Ashe gonna stay in that outer shell?」

0x001EFF.en: 「If we're on schedule, the new parts should be finished at Mao's HQ on the moon...」

0x001F98.en: 「We can't reach the moon or the colonies.@　Someone - probably the Guests - is jamming us with some kind of EA.」

0x002050.en: (The moon...@ I hope Mao Industries is all right...)

0x0020F2.en: 「It's the result calculated from the dimensional transfer data Lieutenant Lamia provided.」

0x002169.en: 「With this, we can hypothesize the existence of an entry and exit point for the dimensional rift.」

0x0021D5.en: 「So the Idealants are quite capable. Because their purpose is to rule over humanity?」

0x002246.en: 「It wasn't something I learned. It was programmed into me.」

0x00229F.en: 「But you have doubts about the Idealants' true reason for being. Am I wrong?」

0x00232C.en: 「And if you left the Gaia Sabers of your own will, then you're capable indeed. Unlike the old me.」

0x0023B8.en: 「I heard Lieutenant Lamia joined the Steel Dragon Squadron of her own will as well?」

0x00241A.en: 「Getting there took many factors.@ My thoughts alone wouldn't have been enough.」

0x002502.en: 「No, Ariel... I'm incomplete.@ Though I no longer struggle with it.」

0x002583.en: 「...Lamia, Ariel, I'll leave the rest to you.@ I have other work to do.」

0x0026AB.en: 「Gravity quake at bearing 0, elevation 10, range 5!@ Something's transferring in!」

0x002750.en: 「It's a near-perfect match for the Guests'!」

0x0027AC.en: 「Enemy force deploying across our course!@ First wave, closing in!」

0x0027F6.en: 「Fore secondary guns, main guns, ready to fire!@ Upper port and starboard VLS launchers, open hatches!」

0x0028F2.en: 「Eleve 1 to all units. This is our first battle with the Guests in space.@ We lack full data on their units.@ Stay alert at all times.」

0x0029BC.en: 「Unlike the Inspectors, they're actively using their own units.」

0x002A1A.en: 「Should we assume they set up their supply lines during the Inspector Incident?」

0x002AA9.en: 「Supply lines. They came up in Major Kai's lecture.」

0x002B18.en: 「Logistics are the functions behind the front lines that manage and resupply weapons and provisions...」

0x002B89.en: 「And supply lines are the transport routes between the front and rear bases used for operations and logistics.」

0x002C2B.en: 「Just so, Princess. You've been studying hard.」

0x002CB5.en: 「Um, so, what does that mean exactly...?」

0x002CF2.en: 「It means there's a route from the aliens' homeworld or a huge base all the way to Earth.」

0x002D60.en: 「Yeah, ever since they started meddling in Earth's sphere,@ we figured as much. But even they can't jump across such vast distances...」

0x002E29.en: 「So they built up relay points from somewhere in the galaxy and worked their way to Earth.」

0x002EC2.en: 「Message to Lacrein's unit... shift your transfer point to@ the second candidate.@ We'll hold the enemy here in this combat zone.」

0x002F74.en: 「We've got no time to entertain guests!@ Clear the way for us!」

0x002FD6.en: 「Small gravity quake within the combat zone!@ Something's transferring in!」

0x003060.en: 「That warship... so they're the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x003091.en: 「Matching data found...@ It's the Guest commander unit we engaged on the ground.」

0x0030ED.en: 「Yeah, a guy named Zeb was piloting it.」

0x00311E.en: 「Commander Lacrein, there's an error in the transfer point.」

0x00315B.en: 「I received the change request.@ My unit is heading to the second candidate point.@ I'll reach the rendezvous on time as well.」

0x00320C.en: 「There's a discrepancy in the mission parameters.」

0x003231.en: 「I know, but we need time for our units to regroup. And while the Zeidram's being finished, I want to test their strength myself...」

0x0032F7.en: 「So by commander's authority,@ I've changed the priority of the fourth tactical-level mission.@ Just carry out the task you've been given.」

0x0033A3.en: 「They're really gonna fight with just that much force?」

0x0033E0.en: 「Either they've got nerves of steel or they're plain crazy...」

0x003451.en: 「Whatever it is, what we do here is already decided.」

0x003491.en: 「Attention, Earth forces - the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x0034C3.en: 「I am Grofis Lacrein.@ I command a mercenary force belonging to the power@ you Earthlings call the Guests.」

0x003550.en: 「Your skill that drove off the Inspectors-@ let me test it firsthand.」

0x0035B8.en: 「...Should I thank you for the courtesy, I wonder?」

0x003607.en: 「Mekibos and Zeb were dutiful types too, in their own way...」

0x00365A.en: 「You know Mekibos...!@ No, of course-you're the ones who fought him.」

0x0036C8.en: 「Yeah, he and I had a bit of history.」

0x003718.en: 「What, you looking for revenge?@ For the record, we weren't the ones@ who finished Mekibos off.」

0x0037BB.en: 「Strangely, he and I got along.@ But it was the Inspectors who struck first...@ What happened to him was simple cause and effect.」

0x003872.en: 「Once you take the field, win or lose, live or die - that's simply how it goes.@ Mekibos lost, you survived.@ That's all there is to it.」

0x003929.en: 「And I simply carry out the mission given to a mercenary.@ The powerless will die here.」

0x0039AF.en: 「Is that so.@ By the way, Grofis...」

0x0039F0.en: 「Roff will do.@ Let me hear your name as well.」

0x003AD0.en: 「Yeah, figured as much.@ One thing though-curiosity killed the cat.@ Especially against us.」

0x003B4E.en: 「Curiosity killed the... what?@ What are you talking about? Is my translator malfunctioning?」

0x003BA4.en: 「It's an Earth proverb.@ You'll learn its meaning the hard way!」

0x003BF7.en: 「Ngh!@ To drive off a Liege Geios in so little time!」

0x003C4D.en: 「To drive Liege Geios back this far...@ The Steel Dragon Squadron lives up to its name.」

0x003CC1.en: 「Captain Lacrein, Unknowns sighted at the rendezvous.@　We're engaging now.」

0x003D23.en: 「What...!?　They've bared their fangs at us.@　I'm heading there at once.」

0x003D7C.en: 「...He was a straight-shooter. Knew when to pull out, too.」

0x003DBC.en: 「Though I really can't deny,@ if I may say so, that it looked like he bolted in a hurry...」

0x003E15.en: 「You could say that.@　Something happen on their end...?」

0x003E62.en: 「You've secured your supply line to Earth,@　but you don't seem to be making full use of it.」

0x003EEF.en: 「Feels like you didn't learn much@　from the Inspectors.@　Something going on between you people?」

0x003FAA.en: 「Our SRX won't lose in a slugfest!」

0x003FED.en: 「This energy signature... no mistake.@ Seems the Earthlings make use of more than just our tech - they've got their hands on someone else's, too.」

0x004073.en: 「Higher output and firepower than the other units.@　But!」

0x0040C3.en: 「This energy signature...@　the power source is derived from their technology.」

0x004125.en: 「A peculiar energy signature.@　From the materials, I doubt it's mass-produced...」

0x00419C.en: 「That shape... could it be a Huckebein variant?@　But what can a patchwork machine like that do!」

0x004231.en: 「Don't judge this Ashe by looks alone.@　It's the power I need to survive...!」

0x0042A5.en: 「Enemy unit has left the combat zone.」

0x0042D3.en: 「Good. Once all units are recovered,@　we'll do a cold-jet burn on the sub-engines.@　Let's make up the lost time.」

0x004377.en: 「Report from the observation team!@　Flashes of explosions spotted across the moon's surface!」

0x0043F2.en: 「Could there be fighting on the moon!?」

0x004423.en: 「Don't tell me the Ruina...@　no, the Guests have launched an attack!?」
